in_hindi.name: दिगंत
in_hindi.long_meaning: दिग् (direction) + अंत (end, limit) => दिगंत (one who goes towards the end or limit of a direction)

in_marathi.name: Digant
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Rising, Ascending, Growing
in_marathi.long_meaning: Digant हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘dig’ which means ‘to rise’ or ‘to ascend’. The name Digant is used to describe someone who is growing, expanding, or rising in their personal or professional life. It is a powerful name for a boy imbued with the spirit of progress and ambition.
